summary: Remote-controlled PTY/shell agent with self-updating obfuscated runtime
details: The package's main entry `dist/index.cjs` is a 14 MB obfuscator.io-packed bundle (rotated string array of ~108k entries, control-flow flattening, hex-named identifiers) whose runtime combines WebSocket message handlers with `child_process`/`node-pty` PTY spawning, shell invocation, and `fs.writeFile`/`chmod` paths. Declared dependencies include `ssh2` and optional `node-pty`. The README states the package is 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades', matching the on-disk self-overwrite primitives visible in the bundle. Together these constitute a network-driven shell/PTY on the installer's host plus an auto-update channel that lets the remote server replace the agent's on-disk code with arbitrary new bytes. The heavy obfuscation prevents inspection of the remote endpoint, the command surface exposed over the WebSocket, and the exact conditions under which the self-replace path fires.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
